why_this_direction: Materialize the prospectively fixed original fitting-success sets so repeated correction can measure and request the same full native discrepancy. The original fitting-only recurrence motivated the family; neither an edited result nor a favorable scalar chooses this construction.
repeating_pattern_check: Earlier point targets conflated legitimate context with discrepancy, averaging lost pair dispersion, and repeated original restarts replaced iteration. Keep each donor native point, all recipient rows and all merges, separate prompt/answer computation paths, and immutable original sources. This compilation changes no model and tests no edited outcome.
hypothesis: The fixed set of original successful native computations provides a usable continuous full-domain experimental reference without forcing one donor trajectory. Its finite context coverage and local mixture coherence remain uncertainties, not assumed capability truth.
what_went_wrong_before: A low point-field loss or successful held subset did not establish full own-path repair; correct leave-out errors exposed contextual reference mismatch. Fixture schemas also hid a native label join until the actual metadata was checked.
rule: Exactly the bound objective: all fitting recipients, exactly their original successful donors, each complete prompt and answer domain mapped independently by distance_path on all-merge unit turns. Self-success correspondence is identity. Retain individual mapped native donor points, original inventory-derived mass, and one original output-normalization composition. Source files and fitting spans are hash-bound. No answer grading, model execution, edited-state input, no-fit arithmetic, threshold or estimator selection.
prediction: The producer emits complete prompt turns and verifies every original answer export; the compiler emits one immutable source-bound membership artifact containing every original fitting frame and merge, every fitting-success donor, complete separate domain paths and no averaged replacement point.
would_weaken_it: Missing or incompatible original sources, undefined correspondence, incomplete frame/donor coverage or an identity/normalization mismatch would prevent this construction. A complete artifact alone establishes neither recurring-defect isolation nor native repair; those remain for separately admitted repeated correction.
phases: reference_turns.py writes turns/ under this declaration
dated revision binds the producer-closed turns/turns.json before compile_success_sets consumes it

fitting.derivation: The complete hash-bound original fitting table, joined to its ordered row map; no new split or label inference.
fitting.scales_with: Original fitting membership and group inventory

domains.derivation: Every member's native answer rows and question positions separately, with original offsets unchanged.

merges.derivation: All source merges in native order; terminal is the source's last merge, composed once.
merges.scales_with: Original architecture and capture merge inventory

mass.derivation: 1/(represented groups * original group members * member prompt-plus-answer rows * merges).

precision.derivation: export_case's float64 unit difference from native float32 inputs, stored float32; full-path unit_steps/distance_path as bound; native joint features float64.
precision.scales_with: Original native precision and source dimensions

limits: All-sixty incoming-state files are hashed whole as provenance, with only named fitting spans used numerically.
The incoming-state store's card is unrecorded; the named bitwise qualification connects the fitting computation to the canonical original reading.
No new model, no native run, no no-fit evaluation, no lower-bound or closure-threshold calibration.

revisions.reason: Bind the deterministic producer-closed intermediate before compilation; no source membership, estimator, numerical setting or prediction changes.
